# A pop spark: a small faceted diamond 0.14 m (unlit, cream), pooled: bursts when a fruit is caught.
new
material new Spark --base-color 0.9490 0.9412 0.8980 --no-slot --emission 0.9490 0.9412 0.8980
add mesh cube --name Spark --size 0.14 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 45 35 0
material assign Spark
select all
shade flat
export spark.glb
